meta.title: Server game history
meta.description: Completed games on the Wardogs server from the Warcon records retained by Logi: faction results, player rankings and the game list.

title: Server game history
intro: Completed games on the Wardogs server from the Warcon records retained by Logi: faction win shares, player rankings and the list of games with their scores.
note: This is server gameplay history, not clan results: factions are not clan teams, players are not verified members and games are not official Wardogs League results. Completed-game statistics differ from Warcon's live leaderboard, which counts time differently.
synthetic: Synthetic demo data – not real games on a Valkyria server.
